thread:
Ava: hey folks — any recs for the night market near Pier 70? thinking of heading there after the offsite.
Miguel: yes! go for the Xian-style lamb skewers from Stall 12. spicy but worth it :fire:
Priya: also the oyster bar next to the food truck row is insanely fresh. cash only tho.
Ken: if you're with a group, try the taiyaki place — fish-shaped pastries with custard + matcha ice cream.
Ava: sweet. is there seating or picnic vibe?
Miguel: bring a blanket, a lot is bench/picnic seating. there's a covered patio at the north end.
Sami: pro tip — arrive ~7pm to avoid the long lines for the ramen stall.
Priya: anyone want to meet up? I'm nearby at the dock cafe around 6:30.
Ken: @Priya I'll come. @Ava Miguel Sami — voting: ramen vs skewers vs seafood
Ava: ramen > skewers
Miguel: skewers > seafood
Sami: ramen > seafood
Priya: seafood > ramen
Ken: tie-breaker: seafood (oysters) :oyster:
Ava: Poll says ramen and seafood tied-ish, let's split up and reconvene? group flexibility.
Miguel: works. if you want to pre-order for pickup use the NightMarket app: https://nightmarket.example/order
Ava: nice — can someone snag a picnic table if they get there first?
Priya: I can. will post pic emoji when I claim one :pinched_fingers:
snack-bot: Reminder — public transit runs until 12:30am from Embarcadero. Check Muni updates: `muni.status`.
Ken: bringing cash and Venmo u/charge
Sami: cool. see y'all there! :raised_hands:
